description: <attemptDir>/receipt.json. The physical result of the attempt, published once by the supervisor (or by adopt when the supervisor is gone). It is not the work result: the settle-attempt step judges the work.

fields.gateExit: the gate-exit.v1 object, or absent when no gate-exit.json exists

captureDigests.stdout: "sha256:<hex>" of the capture file bytes or null when absent

fields.outboxPresent: boolean, an outbox result-<N>.json exists in launch.outboxDir
fields.reason: optional string; `start-refused:<code>` on abandoned-not-started when the supervisor named why it never bound (start-refused.json), e.g. lock-held on Windows; `terminal:<outcome>` or `terminal:blocked:<reason>` when a terminal adapter outcome (agent-protocol terminal-outcomes.v1.json) ended the run early

outcomeRule: output-limit: gate-exit.stoppedBy == output-limit (the capture files passed launch.maxOutputBytes and the supervisor stopped the agent)
gate-lost: a binding exists but the gate died without gate-exit.json (the domain is empty because the lock is free)
carrier-lost: terminal mode; the terminal carrier died or was replaced (terminal-control inspect: pane gone or incarnation changed) while the gate had not published gate-exit.json
abandoned-not-started: no binding; adopt found the lock free

orphan with cause orphan-result maps to exited when an outbox result exists, else to gate-lost; orphan with cause abandoned-before-brief maps to abandoned-before-brief (terminal mode; nothing ran after GO)
outboxWins: an outbox result is settled whatever the outcome; the Run Result Evaluator still judges it
